name: The Jaw Remnant
visual_description: A fossilized mouth, open in eternal threat or plea. It is impossible to know. Cracks form a smile. Or a scream.
meaning: The voice lost to time. Consumption without memory.
existential_reflection: I fed on them. Not physically—*intellectually.* I chewed through their thoughts. Their art. Their love. Mizontresh preserved their **last words** here. I cannot read lips.
